abstract: Reliable measurements of multiple single-sensor color filter array video cameras have recently been obtained. These can be used to augment the Television Lighting Consistency Index Qa [European Broadcasting Union Recommendation R-137 Television Lighting Consistency Index (TLCI)-2012] and the Standard Camera Model, which were mainly based on modern broadcast HDTV cameras with three-sensor technology. During the development of TLCI-2012, an interest in single-sensor cameras was noted, but reliable measurements were difficult and only one example was available under NonDisclosure Agreement from the manufacturer.
